source: TSTD / ADB TA 7305-CAM technical manual, "សណ្តែកត្រើង (សណ្តែកកួរ)" [Yard-long bean cultivation manual]
text: This detailed TSTD/ADB TA 7305-CAM manual on yard-long bean (referred to in the source alternately as សណ្តែកត្រើង and សណ្តែកកួរ) covers land preparation with attention to drainage (the crop dislikes waterlogging) and recommends organic mulch around the planting area to conserve soil moisture and suppress weeds, particularly valuable for this crop's long growing/harvesting season compared to short-duration pulses.
